say:4:1410458301:0.source_cn: 你们整天说这是恩典，可我们不过是渴望活下去……

say:5:1410458302:0.text: Caiden and Bethwyn wasted away before our eyes. You watched them wither, yet you wouldn't spare even a drop of dew!
say:5:1410458302:0.source_cn: 凯登和贝丝薇的生命已经消逝了，你们眼睁睁地看着他们孽化...

say:6:1410458303:0.text: And what of the nobles? They hoard ten times what we receive. Why?!
say:6:1410458303:0.source_cn: 然而贵族们呢？一人能分到我们十倍的量！凭什么？

say:7:1410458304:1.text: We're the ones keeping Sal'thorin standing! We serve, we toil, and yet we are left to starve!
say:7:1410458304:1.source_cn: 维持萨洛克兰，伺候他们的都是我们！

say:9:1410458305:0.text: My sister was so proud, so happy to be chosen for the royal city... Not long after, news of her death came.
say:9:1410458305:0.source_cn: 我的姐姐满心欢喜地被选入了王城……没过多久，就传来了她...

say:10:1410458306:1.text: All because she spilled a glass of wine! Just an ordinary glass of wine, not even the precious Divine Dew!
say:10:1410458306:1.source_cn: 就因为打翻了酒水，只是一杯普通的酒酿，甚至不是宝贵的恩...

say:11:1410458307:1.source_cn: 那个时候，你们又在哪里！

say:12:1410458308:0.text: You're tools for their rule! Look at us!
say:12:1410458308:0.source_cn: 你们不过是维系着贵族们统治的工具！看看我们吧——

say:13:1410458309:1.text: Look at your own people! We are suffering, and now you raise your swords against us?
say:13:1410458309:1.source_cn: 看看你们的同胞！我们正经受着苦难，你们现在却要挥刀砍向...

say:16:1410458310:1.text: See now, Merlin? This is the truth of Sal'thorin... The commoners fight to survive, and the nobles fight to keep their power.
say:16:1410458310:1.source_cn: 这就是萨洛克兰的真相……平民渴求生存，贵族维护特权。
say:16:1410458310:1.male: See now, Merlin? This is the truth of Sal'thorin... The commoners fight to survive, and the nobles fight to keep their power.
say:16:1410458310:1.female: See now, Merlin? This is the truth of Sal'thorin... The commoners fight to survive, and the nobles fight to keep their power.

say:17:1410458311:1.text: And we... we are the line that holds it all together.
say:17:1410458311:1.source_cn: 而我们……是夹在中间的执法者。
say:17:1410458311:1.male: And we... we are the line that holds it all together.
say:17:1410458311:1.female: And we... we are the line that holds it all together.

choice_prompt:18:1410458311.text: And we... we are the line that holds it all together.
choice_prompt:18:1410458311.source_cn: 而我们……是夹在中间的执法者。
choice_prompt:18:1410458311.male: And we... we are the line that holds it all together.
choice_prompt:18:1410458311.female: And we... we are the line that holds it all together.

say:19:1410458312:1.text: ... There's only so much we can do. The time hasn't come yet. Now I must stop them—
say:19:1410458312:1.source_cn: ……我们能做的有限。契机也没有到来。现在我得阻止他们——
say:19:1410458312:1.male: ... There's only so much we can do. The time hasn't come yet. Now I must stop them—
say:19:1410458312:1.female: ... There's only so much we can do. The time hasn't come yet. Now I must stop them—

say:20:1410458313:1.text: If I don't handle it myself, the punishment awaiting them will be even more terrible.
say:20:1410458313:1.source_cn: 否则，等待他们的惩罚会更加可怕。
say:20:1410458313:1.male: If I don't handle it myself, the punishment awaiting them will be even more terrible.
say:20:1410458313:1.female: If I don't handle it myself, the punishment awaiting them will be even more terrible.

say:23:1410458314:1.text: Everyone, stand down! Do you want the entire commoners' district to lose access to the Divine Dew?
say:23:1410458314:1.source_cn: 所有人，立刻停止！你们想要整个平民区都失去获取灵露的资格吗？
say:23:1410458314:1.male: Everyone, stand down! Do you want the entire commoners' district to lose access to the Divine Dew?
say:23:1410458314:1.female: Everyone, stand down! Do you want the entire commoners' district to lose access to the Divine Dew?

say:24:1410458315:0.text: What more do we have to lose? We've lost everything already!
say:24:1410458315:0.source_cn: 我们还能失去什么？我们失去的早就够多了！

say:25:1410458316:0.text: I understand your pain. I do. But if you don't stop now, the coming punishment will affect everyone.
say:25:1410458316:0.source_cn: 听着，我理解你们的痛苦。但如果不立即停止，接下来的惩罚...

say:26:1410458317:0.text: Understand? What do you guards know of suffering?
say:26:1410458317:0.source_cn: 理解？你们这些执法者懂什么！

say:27:1410458318:1.text: This is my final warning! Put down the Divine Dew and leave in an orderly manner! Or else—
say:27:1410458318:1.source_cn: 最后警告！放下恩典灵露，有序退回！否则——

say:29:1410458319:0.text: Or else what? You'll do to us what you did to my sister?
say:29:1410458319:0.source_cn: 否则什么？要像对待我姐姐那样对待我们吗？

say:30:1410458320:1.text: Enough! Guards, contain the situation! No further bloodshed!
say:30:1410458320:1.source_cn: 够了！卫兵们，控制局势。避免更大的骚乱！

say:31:1410458321:1.text: If this reaches the other two Exarchs, the consequences will be beyond anyone's control.
say:31:1410458321:1.source_cn: 一定要阻止事态扩大。如果消息传到其他两位长老那里，后果...

choice:18:0:1.text: I don't know what to say...
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 秩序竟然建立在痛苦之上
choice:18:0:1.male: I don't know what to say...
choice:18:0:1.female: I don't know what to say...
